v14-8.candidate: Jonathan said, “Behold, we will cross to the men and roll down toward them.

v14-16.candidate: Saul’s lookouts in Benjamin’s Geba looked, and behold, the camp was in turmoil this way and that.

v14-17.candidate: Saul said to the people with him, “Please muster and see who has gone from you.” They mustered, and behold, Jonathan and the one carrying his equipment could not be found.

v14-20.candidate: Saul and all the people with him cried out and came to the battle. Behold, each man’s sword was against his neighbour, with exceedingly great confusion.

v14-24.candidate: Saul acted with great ignorance that day and laid a curse upon the people: “Cursed is the man who eats bread before evening. And I will take vengeance on my enemy.” None of the people tasted bread.

v14-26.candidate: The people entered the bee-place. There he was, going along and speaking; behold, no one was bringing his hand back to his mouth, for the people feared the Lord’s oath.

v14-30.candidate: But if the people had eaten freely today from their enemies’ spoils that they found, the blow against the foreigners would now have been greater.”

v14-34.candidate: Saul said, “Scatter among the people and tell them to bring here each man his calf and each man his sheep. Let him slaughter it upon this, and you will certainly not sin against the Lord by eating with the blood.” All the people brought what each had in his hand and slaughtered there.

v14-39.candidate: For as the Lord lives, who saved Israel, if an answer is given against my son Jonathan, he must certainly die.” But none of all the people answered.
